eg.text: السلام عليكم! أنا زياد. إنت اسمَك إيه؟
أنا من كندا، بس أصلاً من مصر.

en.text: Thanks. I'm Sami. What's your name?
I'm Layla. Nice to meet you.
Oh, that's my flight! Bye, Sami! Have a nice day!
Yes, I do, mainly because it's quiet and close to the sea. For example, every Friday I walk along the beach with my family.
Do you work or are you a student?
What do you like to do in your free time?
